name: The Guns of Will Sonnett
description: Ex-cavalry scout and gunfighter Will Sonnett and his grandson, Jeff, search the West for Will's son—and Jeff's father—Jim Sonnett, a former lawman and gunslinger, who has avoided seeing his son in order to keep him away from the assortment of killers and bounty hunters who are after him.

videos.title: Ride the Long Trail
videos.overview: A travelling show arrives in town, claiming to have guns from famous gunslingers.  Of particular interest to young Jeff Sonnett is a gun that supposedly belonged to his infamous father, James.  Never having known his father, Jeff convinces his grandfather, Will, to help him find his father, no matter how long it takes.   The first stop is a small town where the Sonnetts find a man who lost an arm in a gunfight with James Sonnett and is looking for revenge on anyone with the name Sonnett.

videos.title: A Bell for Jeff Sonnett
videos.overview: An up and coming gunslinger who puts a small bell on his belt for each person he's killed wants to add the Sonnett name to his reputation.

videos.title: A Grave for James Sonnett
videos.overview: Will and Jeff find a grave marked for James Sonnett in a small Mexican town.  James had been protecting the town from bandits,a job that his son and father decide to finish.  In the end, it turns out that the grave was only a ruse to throw the bandits off the trail of a wounded James Sonnett, so the search continues.

videos.title: The Natural Way
videos.overview: Will and Jeff sign on as deputies in order to come to the aid of a wounded sheriff.

videos.title: Of Lasting Summers and Jim Sonnett
videos.overview: Will and Jeff go to Wyoming to see whether a man scheduled to hang is really Jim Sonnett.

videos.title: Message at Noon
videos.overview: When Will and Jeff realize Jim is only a day's ride away, they send an urgent wire to convince him to wait for them.

videos.title: A Son for a Son
videos.overview: Jeff is wounded in a gunfight and taken in by a family who share a dark secret: one of their sons was killed by James Sonnett.  After framing Will for theft, the Father plans to kill Jeff as soon as he can hold a gun.  The distraught Mother has other ideas, wanting to keep Jeff as her own son.

videos.title: Meeting at Devil's Fork
videos.overview: A bounty hunter takes Jeff and Will prisoner to lure Jim Sonnett to Devil's Fork.

videos.title: First Love
videos.overview: When Will and Jeff land in jail, a beautiful woman puts up the bail and asks them to stay in town.

videos.title: The Favor
videos.overview: Will and Jeff stumble upon a wounded man in a ghost town saloon.

videos.title: Ride the Man Down
videos.overview: A sheriff rounds up a possee to hunt down Jim Sonnett after a dying bank robber wrongly names the gunslinger as his accomplice.

videos.title: The Turkey Shoot
videos.overview: Jeff wins a prize bull in a shooting contest.

videos.title: And a Killing Rode into Town
videos.overview: Will and Jeff encounter a woman who claims to be Jeff's mother.

videos.title: Find a Sonnett, Kill a Sonnett
videos.overview: When two vengeful brothers take Jeff hostage, Will convinces an old friend to impersonate Jim Sonnett.

videos.title: Sunday in Paradise
videos.overview: Will helps an old friend convince townspeople to finance and build a house of worship.

videos.title: The Secret of Hangtown Mine
videos.overview: The Sonnets visit a ranch looking for information about Jim, but they uncover a murder instead.

videos.title: The Hero
videos.overview: After two bank robbers wound Will, Jeff pursues them into Apache country.

videos.title: What's in a Name?
videos.overview: Will and Jeff encounter a man who claims to be Will Sonnett.

videos.title: End of the Rope
videos.overview: Will and Jeff race to Waco, where Jim Sonnett stands trial for murder.

videos.title: And He Shall Lead the Children
videos.overview: Will and Jeff unwittingly stumble upon an outlaw's mountain cabin.

videos.title: Look for the Hound Dog
videos.overview: Will pleads Jeff's case after a lynch mob accuses the boy of murdering a storekeeper.

videos.title: Stopover in a Troubled Town
videos.overview: A woman working in a saloon needs the Sonnetts' help when her father decides to come for a visit.

videos.title: Alone
videos.overview: Will arranges to meet Jeff in a ghost town saloon, but he ends up getting caught in a hail of rifle bullets instead.

videos.title: The Sins of the Father
videos.overview: Jeff starts to fall for a young woman who claims that James Sonnett is the father of her infant son.

videos.title: The Warriors
videos.overview: Will goes undercover for the Cavalry to help stop a gunrunner from selling rifles that may start a new Indian war.

videos.title: A Fool and His Money
videos.overview: Will & Jeff help an old friend pretend to be a rich rancher in order to impress his mail order bride.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: A young man rides into town and claims to be Jim Sonnett's long-lost son.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Will and Jeff are arrested on trumpted up charges and forced to work on a chain gang, blasting a tunnel through a mountain for the railroad.  Once there, the two find that any traveller passing through town has been bushwhacked and forced to work until they drop dead while the Sheriff and the Judge pocket the proceeds.

videos.title: Chapter and Verse
videos.overview: The Sonnett's encounter a bounty hunter team who are pursuing Jim Sonnett and other fugitives. Will challenges their ruthless tactics and use of Bible scriptures to justify them and later discovers they have crossed the line.

videos.title: Pariah
videos.overview: The father of a little girl killed by a stray bullet during a gunfight with James Sonnett tries to exact revenge on Will and James' old friend Buck Cobb.  The father goads Will into a gunfight by burning Buck's homestead to the ground.

videos.title: Joby
videos.overview: A peaceable small town begins to experience an unusual amount of fighting.

videos.title: The Straw Man
videos.overview: Will and Jeff find a straw effigy of James Sonnett hanging in a town.  A young widow has accused James of killing and robbing her husband but when Will does some digging, the real facts come to light.

videos.title: A Difference of Opinion
videos.overview: Will & Jeff run into a couple of crooked lawmen who claim to have run Jim Sonnett out of town.

videos.title: Home Free
videos.overview: Will and Jeff try to help a man recently released from prison to get a new start with his wife and child. Unfortunately, others in the town aren't as willing to give the young man another chance, including an old friend of Will's from the Army.

videos.title: Guilt
videos.overview: Will and Jeff become unwittingly entangled in a senseless blood feud.

videos.title: Meeting in a Small Town
videos.overview: In a small Mexican border settlement, Will and Jeff encounter a bounty hunter gunning for Jim.

videos.title: The Fearless Man
videos.overview: Jeff admires a seemingly fearless stranger with a dark secret.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: An accused man claims that James Sonnett's testimony can clear his name.

videos.title: One Angry Juror
videos.overview: While Jeff lies sick with a fever in a hotel room, Will is forced into jury duty.  A Swedish farmer is accused of murdering the son of a wealthy rancher but refuses to testify in his own defense.  Will suspects that the case isn't as open and shut as it seems.

videos.title: The Man Who Killed James Sonnett
videos.overview: Will and Jeff disprove the premise of a play in which Jim Sonnett is killed. Will: Walter Brennan. Jeff: Dack Rambo. Morris: Jay Novello. Laurie: Joan Van Ark. Sheriff Devon: Robert F. Simon. Charlie: John Crawford.

videos.title: Three Stand Together
videos.overview: After two long years of searching, Will and Jeff finally catch up to Jim Sonnett.  Will convinces James that it's time to stop running, so the three take jobs as lawmen in a small town. Trouble doesn't take long to find the Sonnetts - a group of men paid to kill James ride into town only to find that James isn't the only fast gun in the family.
